body.paper_only: paper totals; never mixed with funded totals

equity.ending_basis: INCOMPLETE: 12 open position(s) have no available mark; total equity is not stated and the marked-only figure excludes them

breadth.definition: distinct us_market_slug with a filled purchase that day; repeat orders or both sides of one market count once

drawdown.basis: peak-to-trough over paper_equity_snapshots (one per paper pass), marks as in bettor_paper_ledger.MARK_METHOD

pinnacle_completed_game_paper.disclosure: PINNACLE_COMPLETED_GAME_PAPER: EXPERIMENTAL PAPER EXECUTION on a fictional account. The reference probability is the de-vigged Pinnacle probability alone. Every fill is SIMULATED (PAPER_SIM_V1). It does not qualify any strategy for real money. No real money, no real venue order.
